description: This file defines the TimeCheck class, which monitors execution time of code blocks, providing timeout handling, callbacks, and integration with a TimerThread. It includes mechanisms for detecting long-running operations and handling timeouts, primarily used as a watchdog in Android media utilities.

classes.name: TimeCheck
classes.description: A class that monitors execution time for code blocks, triggering callbacks or aborts if timeouts occur.

classes.description: Helper class managing event handling for TimeCheck, including timeout and cancel events.
